turns.text: How did today go?
Eh, worked on stuff. The migration mostly. Some meetings.
What part of the migration did you get done?
Just poking at it, nothing finished really.
What stood out today?
Today was all mentoring. I paired with the intern for most of the afternoon on their first real feature, and I reviewed a design doc from a new hire. No code from me at all.
What changed for them?
The intern said they finally understand how our deploy pipeline works, and the new hire rewrote their doc after my comments.
What did you get done?
I rewrote the event consumer to batch inserts. Throughput went from 500 to 2,000 events a second, so like 4x.

turns.text: How did the backfill go?
It finished. We moved about 18k merchant records into the new schema without any downtime.
What stood out today?
I helped a teammate debug the flaky checkout tests. They did most of the fixing, I mainly spotted that the test clock wasn't frozen.
You tuned the cache today. Did latency change?
It feels a lot faster, but honestly I don't know the number. I didn't check the dashboard.
How did the migration go?
The ledger migration went well. Reconciliation got 40% faster.
Was that something you led?
Yes, I led it, I wrote the plan and ran the cutover.
How are you doing today?
Tired. I was on call and got paged at 3 am because the payments API was timing out. I found a stuck lock on the orders table, killed the query, and we were back up in about 25 minutes.
How did it end?
Fine in the end. Nothing was lost. I'm just wiped.

metrics.source_text: we were back up in about 25 minutes

turns.text: What stood out today?
The team launched the new onboarding flow. I wrote the email templates for it.
Any early results?
Not yet, it's only been a day.
Anything you learned today?
I learned how Kafka's cooperative sticky assignor avoids stop-the-world rebalances. Also my lead said my design doc was the clearest one this quarter, which was nice.
What happened today?
I'm blocked. The staging database is down and the infra team says it won't be back until Thursday, so I can't test the partition migration.
What will you do tomorrow then?
Tomorrow I'll write the rollback plan instead so it's ready.
What stood out today?
I cut our CI build time. It used to take 14 minutes and now it's around 6. I set up dependency caching and split the test suite into 4 parallel jobs.

turns.text: How did today go?
Long day. Had a tough conversation with a teammate who felt left out of the design decisions, and we agreed they'd own the next design review.
How did they take it?
Better than I expected. They thanked me after.
Before we start, one from yesterday: how many alerts fired per week before and after the threshold change?
I checked, we went from about 40 alerts a week to 6.
Great. What stood out today?
We decided to move the retry state out of Redis and into Postgres so it survives restarts. I pushed for it.
